description: Single-piece open-top organiser for electronics components that fills a Bambu Lab A1 plate: 250 x 250 mm footprint, 70 mm tall, a 5 x 5 grid of 50 mm cells tiled into ten compartments (two single cells, the rest 2x1, 3x1 and one 3x2).
printing_notes: Print floor-down with no supports and no brim: the 250 mm footprint leaves about 3 mm per side on the 256 mm A1 plate. Use a textured plate and a slow first layer to guard against corner lift.
The wall and floor defaults are first guesses to adjust after a test print; the 50 mm grid pitch stays fixed.
The layout is the compartments list in the library; asserts refuse overlaps, gaps or spans of 4 or more cells.
